data.narrative:
Nabla Bio is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Surge Biswas and Frances Anastassacos that has raised $37M in equity plus $1.5B+ in partnerships. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method here. Using the $37M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, this method yields $74M. Peer-median analysis cannot be applied: while 8 same-sector private peers exist, none meet minimum sample thresholds when filtered by stage, valuation tier, or comparable positioning. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is similarly inapplicable; the Biotech & Health public median sits at 6.6x across the three tickers, but Nabla's revenue is not disclosed, preventing ratio application.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $63M to $85M, with a median point of $74M. This range reflects the stage-progression method and applies conservative downside (15% haircut) and upside (15% uplift) sensitivity. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable private peers at this stage and the lack of revenue data, which would enable public-multiple anchoring and strengthen conviction in the estimate.
